text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is requesting approval for the installation of an on-street accessible parking space for a person with disabilities on the west side of Queensbury Avenue.

The Scarborough Community Council: 1. Designated an on-street accessible parking space in effect at all times on the west side of Queensbury Avenue, between a point 253 metres north of Kingston Road and a point 5.5 metres further north.
